title: Decide how acceptance evaluations use the remote hosts: a remote observer with a central judge, or a full remote evaluator
outcome: Decide how acceptance evaluations use the remote hosts: a remote observer with a central judge, or a full remote evaluator
acceptance: One recommendation with its rules is recorded here, carrying each consultee's verdict: Termal::Fable2, Termal::Codex, Engram::Architect3 and Engram::Coder (or its recorded absence). It covers evidence binding to tree and build, replay and staleness, independence, remote work, cost and risk, and any doc or implementation gap
The recommendation was sent to Greg through Engram::Advisor, and his answer (adoption or change) is quoted verbatim with its source
